# Agent Python Tools

- repo: facebookresearch/pytext
- repo_uri: https://github.com/facebookresearch/pytext

## File: facebookresearch_pytext/pytext/data/tokenizers/tokenizer.py

Prompts

```
['create a Tokenizer that splits text using a regex pattern and returns Token named tuples with start and end indices', 'build a WordPieceTokenizer that performs BERT-style basic tokenization followed by wordpiece subword tokenization using a vocab file', 'create a GPT2BPETokenizer that encodes text using GPT-2 BPE encoder and decodes byte pairs back to tokens', 'build a SentencePieceTokenizer that tokenizes text using a SentencePiece model file and returns tokens with character offsets', 'create an SPEandWordTokenizer that uses SentencePiece for general tokens but preserves full words from an ontology vocabulary file']
```

Usage

```
{'tokenize_text_with_regex': 'create a Tokenizer that splits text using a regex pattern and returns Token named tuples with start and end indices', 'tokenize_with_bert_wordpiece': 'build a WordPieceTokenizer that performs BERT-style basic tokenization followed by wordpiece subword tokenization using a vocab file', 'tokenize_with_gpt2_bpe': 'create a GPT2BPETokenizer that encodes text using GPT-2 BPE encoder and decodes byte pairs back to tokens', 'tokenize_with_sentencepiece': 'build a SentencePieceTokenizer that tokenizes text using a SentencePiece model file and returns tokens with character offsets', 'tokenize_with_ontology_vocab': 'create an SPEandWordTokenizer that uses SentencePiece for general tokens but preserves full words from an ontology vocabulary file'}
```
